scientific_integrity: Exact finite exhaustive verification and explicit geometric proof; no assertion of independent validation, external authorship, or formal machine certification.
scientific_limitations: Only possible Frobenius actions, not separate realization of each type over every fixed finite field; sharpness among the complete Weyl-group actions. The 16/40 geometric configurations were already known; an unindexed equivalent joint cycle-index result is a residual priority risk.
title: Three extension counts recover the Frobenius type from the 16 lines and 40 squares of a degree-four del Pezzo surface
